note: Per-hero balance multipliers for Match Sim v2 (damage, healing, shields and health); 1.0 = untouched. Tuned from calibration hero rows (tools/calibrate_v2.py --rows heroes), then in 0.11.1 from equal-team real AI drafts with 1, 3 and 5 bans (tools/tune_heroes_real.py).
dmg_note: Optional damage multiplier per hero; default = scale. 0.11.1: supports raised and carries lowered in the balance pass keep their 0.11.0 damage, so the change goes into health, healing and shields and kills stay with carries (alpha6_tests).
hp_note: 0.11.1: these supports keep their 0.11.0 health; their scale moves healing and shields (and damage where no dmg entry).
